metadata.notes: Form-specific learnability; no runtime download or evolution-history simulation.

notes: Availability is classified per acquisition-method record, not globally per move.
Egg Move methods are intentionally excluded from automated validation and strategy recommendations.
A user-entered unverified move should trigger confirmation rather than hard rejection.
Level 0 records are preserved as source values and should not be interpreted as ordinary level-up levels.
No transfer or event acquisition-method records are present in this Sword/Shield version-group dataset.

availability_policy.base_game: Supported for move validation and strategy recommendations.
availability_policy.dlc_isle_of_armor: Legal Sword/Shield method but excluded from base-Sword recommendations.
availability_policy.excluded_egg_move: Egg Move method intentionally excluded from automated validation and strategy recommendations.

egg_move_policy.ui_note: If Battle Compass cannot verify a user-entered move, the user may confirm that the Pokemon definitely knows it, including through breeding.
